abstract: PURPOSE: To investigate whether preoperative serum anti-mullerian hormone (AMH) levels are lower in women with ovarian endometrioma and in women with mature cystic teratoma of the ovaries. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In a tertiary university hospital, a retrospective case-control study was performed. Serum AMH levels between an advanced (stage III and IV) endometrioma group (n=102) and an age- and body mass index (BMI)-matched control group were compared. Serum AMH levels between an ovarian mature cystic teratoma group (n=48) and age- and BMI-matched controls were also compared. RESULTS: Absolute serum AMH and multiples of the median for AMH (AMH-MoM) relevant to Korean standards were lower in the endometrioma group than controls, but this was not statistically significant (mean±SEM, 2.9±0.3 ng/mL vs. 3.3±0.3 ng/mL, p=0.28 and 1.3±0.1 vs. 1.6±0.1, p=0.29, respectively). Specifically, the stage IV endometriosis group (n=51) exhibited significantly lower serum AMH and AMH-MoM (2.1±0.3 vs. 3.1±0.4 ng/mL, p=0.02 and 1.1±0.1 vs. 1.7±0.2, p=0.03, respectively). Serum AMH and AMH-MoM levels were similar between stage III endometriosis and controls (3.7±0.5 vs. 3.4±0.5 ng/mL and 1.6±0.2 vs. 1.5±0.2, respectively), as well as between the mature cystic teratoma group and controls (4.0±0.5 ng/mL vs. 4.0±0.5 ng/mL and 1.6±0.2 vs. 1.6±0.3, respectively). Interestingly, AMH-MoM level was negatively correlated with endometriosis score with statistical significance (r²=0.13, p<0.01). CONCLUSION: In women with advanced ovarian endometrioma, preoperative serum AMH values tended to be lower than those for age and BMI-matched controls. Notably, stage IV endometrioma appeared to be closely associated with decreased ovarian reserve, even before operation. Clinicians should keep this information in mind before undertaking surgery of ovarian endometrioma.
abstract_ja:
目的：卵巣子宮内膜症および卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の女性において、術前血清抗ミュラー管ホルモン(AMH)値が低いかどうかを検討すること。
対象と方法：三次医療機関において後方視的症例対照研究を実施した。進行期(III期およびIV期)の子宮内膜症群(n=102)と年齢およびBMIをマッチさせた対照群の血清AMH値を比較した。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫群(n=48)についても、年齢およびBMIをマッチさせた対照群と血清AMH値を比較した。
結果：子宮内膜症群における血清AMH絶対値およびAMH-MoM(韓国の基準値に対する中央値倍数)は対照群より低かったが、統計学的な有意差はなかった(平均±SEM、2.9±0.3 ng/mL対3.3±0.3 ng/mL、p=0.28；1.3±0.1対1.6±0.1、p=0.29)。特にIV期子宮内膜症群(n=51)では、血清AMHおよびAMH-MoMが有意に低かった(2.1±0.3対3.1±0.4 ng/mL、p=0.02；1.1±0.1対1.7±0.2、p=0.03)。III期子宮内膜症と対照群の血清AMHおよびAMH-MoMは同程度であった(3.7±0.5対3.4±0.5 ng/mL、1.6±0.2対1.5±0.2)。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫群と対照群の間にも差はなかった(4.0±0.5 ng/mL対4.0±0.5 ng/mL、1.6±0.2対1.6±0.3)。AMH-MoM値は子宮内膜症スコアと統計学的に有意な負の相関を示した(r²=0.13、p<0.01)。
結論：進行した卵巣子宮内膜症の女性では、術前血清AMH値が年齢およびBMIをマッチさせた対照群より低い傾向があった。特にIV期の子宮内膜症は、手術前の段階ですでに卵巣予備能の低下と関連している可能性がある。卵巣子宮内膜症の手術を検討する際には、この点を念頭に置くべきである。
